# Screenshot provenance

The images in this directory are unedited framebuffer/scanout captures of the
NXExtract 1.1.0 UI running its synthetic device fixture.

- `nxextract-mali-1280x720.png`: SDL `mali` backend at 1280×720.
- `nxextract-kmsdrm-640x480.png`: SDL `KMSDRM` backend at 640×480.

They contain no APK, OBB, game asset, private address, credential, personal
path or raw device log. The UI and these project screenshots are distributed
under the repository's MIT license.
